[EN] Well done, !

Clearly, you possess formidable willpower!
[ES] ¡Bien hecho, !

¡Es evidente que posees una fuerza de voluntad formidable!

[EN] Welcome to the Vault of Oriyn. Treat these hallowed halls with respect.

[EN] I myself have not been inside for a very long time.
[ES] Yo mismo no he entrado en mucho tiempo.
